translations.web: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
translations.bsb: She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.
translations.kjv: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
